source: InboundConnectionIdleHandler (b765b8271). A connection that has read and written nothing for inboundConnectionIdleTimeoutMillis with nothing in progress is closed, a CONNECT or SOCKS tunnel's client leg too; a delayed response, a streaming response's gap, and a WebSocket outlive it (InboundConnectionIdleTimeoutIntegrationTest). Each tcp step reads for two seconds after its last chunk: closed means the server closed it within them

steps.note: a connection that never sends anything
a keep-alive connection, once idle after its response
a delayed response outlives the timeout; then idle
an SSE gap longer than the timeout
a WebSocket quiet for longer than the timeout stays open

tcp.text:
GET /ws HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:{{port}}
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Key: dGhlIHNhbXBsZSBub25jZQ==
Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13

steps.note: a CONNECT tunnel, once idle after its response
a SOCKS5 tunnel: its handshake is no activity (the SOCKS handlers sit in front of the idle handler), so it is closed 600 ms after the accept, before its request at 800 ms
five closed as idle: the silent, keep-alive, delayed, the CONNECT tunnel and the SOCKS one
